data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): DISPATCH GATE — sprint orchestrator MUST verify cde1-30ba-d186-48d2 status==closed before dispatching T3. The current differ.py:36-39 takes (prev_snapshot, next_snapshot) — TWO TIMEPOINTS, ONE SIDE. is_echo requires (local_value, jira_value) — TWO SIDES — which cde1's redesigned compute_mutations(local_state, jira_state) provides. Without cde1's redesign there is no surface to attach the ledger to. /dso:fix-cascade-recovery is post-hoc; replace with a precondition check. If precondition fails: BLOCK T3 (do not dispatch with degraded signature; do not improvise).
